渗透者军士 APL 移动豁免耐伤

战术优势：在每场战斗中，您可以各进行一次以下行动。
• 在进行拼骰来判断先手权时，如果该特工位于杀戮区内，那么您可以重掷您的 D6。
• 在使用一个交战计谋时，如果该特工是计谋指定的恐惧突袭小队特工（如果该特工通过“指挥重掷”计

Tactical Advantage: You can do each of the following once per battle:
• After rolling-off to decide initiative, if this operative is in the killzone, you can re-roll your dice.
• You can use a firefight ploy for 0CP if this is the specified PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operative (including Command Re-roll if the
attack or defence dice was rolled for this operative), or the Patient Ambush firefight ploy for 0CP if this operative is ready and not
within control range of enemy operatives.

cards.text:
渗透者通讯兵 APL 移动豁免耐伤

战略监视：在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，在您获
得 CP 时，如果该特工处于杀戮区内，且不位于敌
方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用本规则。
若这么做，掷一枚 D6：若结果为 4+，您获得额
外 1CP。
通讯阵列：每个转折点限一次，在一名己方恐惧
突袭小队特工的激活或反应期间，在那名特工
执行行动之前或之后，如果该特工位于杀戮区
内，那么您可以更换一个在当前转折点中使用的
战略计谋（这么做不会消耗任何 CP)。
恐惧突袭小队、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、渗透者、通讯兵 32

Strategic Oversight: In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, when you gain CP, if this operative is in the killzone and isn’t within
control range of enemy operatives, you can use this rule. If you do, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain one additional CP.
Comms Array: Once per turning point, during a friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operative’s activation or counteraction, before
or after it performs an action, if this operative is in the killzone, you can change one strategy ploy you’ve used this turning point (it
doesn’t cost you any CP to do so).

cards.text:
渗透者基因医生 APL 移动豁免耐伤
3 7" 3+ 12
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
神射手爆矢卡宾枪 4 3+ 3/4 致命 5+
双拳 4 3+ 3/4 -
医疗兵!：在每个转折点中，首次有另一名位于该特工 3" 内且可见的己方恐惧突袭小队特工将被残废时，
如果该特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规则。若使用，那么那名己方
特工不会被残废，并且剩余 1 点耐伤并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那次行动结束后，那名己方特工
可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束这次移动。直到该特工和那名
特工的下一次激活结束前，他们的 APL 属性各减少 1 点。如果您在那名特工的激活期间使用了本规则，
那么那次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主要或次要目标时
使用此规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
恐惧突袭小队、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、医疗、渗透者、基因医生 32
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
INFILTRATOR HELIX ADEPT
3 7" 3+ 12
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Marksman bolt carbine 4 3+ 3/4 Lethal 5+
Fists 4 3+ 3/4 -
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operative would be incapacitated
while visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of
an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has D3 wounds remaining and cannot be incapacitated for
the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that
move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations
respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this
operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, MEDIC, INFILTRATOR, HELIX ADEPT 32

3 7" 3+ 12

远程引爆器 4 2+ 5/6 重型（仅限冲刺）、有限 1、
穿刺 1、安静、引爆*
双拳 4 3+ 3/4 -
*引爆：不要选择有效目标。作为替代，对己方炸弹标识 2"
内的每一名特工进行射击，除非范围内的特工与标识之间存
在完全阻碍的重型地形模型。每一名被射击的特工无法拥有
掩护或者被遮挡。按照您所决定的顺序来为每一次流程分别
进行掷骰。若己方炸弹标识不位于杀戮区，则您不能选择该
武器。在该行动结束时，将己方炸弹标识移出杀戮区。在
一个使用近距离战斗规则的杀戮区中（如杀戮区：墓穴世
界），本武器拥有“致命 5+”武器规则。
设置炸弹：该特工携带一枚己方的炸弹标识。特工
可以对这个标识执行拾取标识行动，并且在该特工
对该标识使用放置标识行动时，该特工可以立即在
之后执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动。

Plant Explosives: This operative is carrying your Explosives marker. It can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker, and
whenever it performs the Place Marker action on that marker, it can immediately perform a free Dash action.
*Detonate: Don’t select a valid target. Instead, shoot against each operative within 2" of your Explosives marker, unless Heavy terrain
is wholly intervening between that operative and that marker. Each of those operatives cannot be in cover or obscured. Roll each
sequence separately in an order of your choice. This weapon cannot be selected if your Explosives marker isn’t in the killzone. At the
end of the action, remove your Explosives marker from the killzone. In a killzone that uses the close quarters rules (e.g. Killzone: Tomb
World), this weapon has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, INFILTRATOR, SABOTEUR 32

干扰地雷：该特工携带有一枚己方的干扰地雷标识。
该特工可以对这枚标识执行拾取标识行动，但是这
枚标识不能被放置在敌方特工的控制范围内（如果
该特工在携带该标识的期间被残废，那么该标识不
能被放置，将其与特工一同移除)。
感应式地雷：当己方的干扰地雷标识首次位于另一名
特工的控制范围内时，将该标识移除，直到那名特工的
下一次激活结束前，其 APL 属性减少 1 点，并对其造
成 2D3+3 点伤害；如果特工没有因此残废，那么结束
其执行的行动（若有)，就算行动的效果没有被满足。
如果那名特工因此不能被放置，那么移动最短的距离
来满足放置条件。请注意，该特工忽略此规则的效果
（该特工不会触发该标识，也不会受到其造成的伤
害)。
恐惧突袭小队、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、入侵者、布雷兵 32

marker. It can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that
marker, but that marker cannot be placed within an enemy
operative’s control range (if this operative is incapacitated while
carrying that marker and that marker cannot be placed, it’s
removed with this operative).
Proximity Mine: The first time your Haywire Mine marker is
within another operative’s control range, remove that marker,
subtract 1 from that operative’s APL stat until the end of
its next activation, and inflict 2D3+3 damage on it; if it isn’t
incapacitated, end its action (if any), even if that action’s effects
aren’t fulfilled. If it cannot be placed, move it the minimum
amount to do so. Note that this operative is ignored for these
effects (i.e. it cannot set it off or take damage from that marker).
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, INCURSOR, MINELAYER 32

within control range of enemy operatives.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营规则
全方位扰频器
安装在背包上的全方位扰频器能够干扰敌军
的通讯。
战略计划（如果一名己方渗透者特工位于杀戮区
内）。选择对一名己方渗透者特工可见的一名敌
方特工，如果是一名破讯兵特工，则选择一名位
于其 6" 内的敌方特工。在该转折点的交战阶段
中，那个敌方特工不能被激活或者执行行动，直
到满足以下一个条件为止：
• 您的对手激活了相当于在这个战略计划被使用
时位于杀戮区中的己方渗透者特工数量的敌方
特工。
• 被选择的特工是最后一个被激活的敌方特工。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION RULE
OMNI-SCRAMBLER
Backpack-mounted omni-scramblers serve to disrupt
enemy communications.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT if a friendly INFILTRATOR
operative is in the killzone. Select one enemy
operative visible to a friendly INFILTRATOR
operative, or within 6" of a friendly VOXBREAKER
operative. In the Firefight phase of this turning
point, that enemy operative cannot be activated
or perform actions until one of the following
is true:
• Your opponent has activated a number of
enemy operatives equal to the number of
friendly INFILTRATOR operatives in the killzone
when this STRATEGIC GAMBIT was used.
• It’s the last enemy operative to be activated.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营规则
恐惧
星际战士掠夺者是专门的恐惧部队，他们使
用骷髅面具、震荡手雷和受通讯强化的怒吼
来惊吓敌人。
在一名敌方特工位于任何己方掠夺者特工的 3"
内时，您的对手必须消耗额外 1AP 才能让那名
敌方特工执行拾取标识或者任务行动。
在判断对一枚标识的控制权时，如果有至少一名
争夺标识的敌方特工位于己方掠夺者特工的 3"
内，那么将争夺标识的敌方特工的 APL 属性总
和视作为比原本低 1 点。请注意，这不是对 APL
属性的修改，因此任何修改效果会与本规则的效
果叠加。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION RULE
TERROR
Dedicated terror troops, Space Marine Reivers utilise
skull masks, shock grenades and vox-enhanced roars to
terrify their victims.
Whenever an enemy operative is within 3" of
friendly REIVER operatives, your opponent must
spend 1 additional AP for that enemy operative to
perform the Pick Up Marker and mission actions.
Whenever determining control of a marker,
treat the total APL stat of enemy operatives
that contest it as 1 lower if at least one of those
enemy operatives is within 3" of friendly REIVER
operatives. Note this isn’t a change to the APL
stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营规则
阿斯塔特
这些经受了基因强化的超人们的存在意义只
有一个：战争。
在每一名己方恐惧突袭小队特工的激活期间，
特工可以执行两次近战行动或者两次射击行动。
如果选择执行两次射击行动，那么其中至少有一
次必须选择使用一件爆矢武器进行攻击。一件爆
矢武器是任何名称中存在“爆矢”一词的远程武
器，例如神射手爆矢卡宾枪、特种爆矢手枪等。
每一名己方恐惧突袭小队特工可以进行反应，
无论其拥有的命令。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION RULE
ASTARTES
These genetically modified superhumans are made for
one purpose: war.
During each friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
operative’s activation, it can perform either two
Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If it’s two
Shoot actions, a bolt weapon must be selected
for at least one of them. A bolt weapon is any
ranged weapon that includes ‘bolt’ in its name,
e.g. marksman bolt carbine, special issue bolt
pistol, etc.
Each friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operative
can counteract regardless of its order.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营规则
多光谱阵列
多光谱阵列能够将信息传入持有者护甲的自
动感知器中，帮助揭示隐藏的敌人。
每当己方入侵者特工进行射击时，敌方特工不能
被遮挡。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION RULE
MULTI-SPECTRUM ARRAY
Feeding into the auto-senses of the bearer’s armour, the
multi-spectrum array’s powerful augurs help to reveal
hidden foes.
Whenever a friendly INCURSOR operative is
shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
战略计谋
游击战术
恐惧突袭小队通过使用隐匿和伏击来压制自
己的敌人，发起出其不意的突袭。
己方恐惧突袭小队特工可以执行以下独特行动:
游击战术 1AP
更改该特工的命令。
一名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执
行此行动。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
STRATEGY PLOY
GUERRILLA WARFARE
Phobos Strike Teams utilise stealth and ambush tactics
to overwhelm their foes, striking when least expected.
Friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operatives can
perform the following unique action:
GUERRILLA WARFARE 1AP
Change this operative’s order.
An operative cannot perform this
action while within control range of an
enemy operative.

cards.title_en: AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
战略计谋
他们无所畏惧
星际战士拥有超凡的勇气和坚定的意志，就
算是面对究极的恐惧之物或者看似不可能的
绝境也绝不会动摇。
您可以忽略任何己方恐惧突袭小队特工因受创
而导致的属性变化（包括武器数据）。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
STRATEGY PLOY
AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
Space Marines possess superhuman courage and are
utterly unflinching in the face of terrifying horrors and
overwhelming odds.
You can ignore any changes to the stats of
friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operatives from
being injured (including their weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
战略计谋
致命射手
星际战士花费了漫长的时间将自己的射击技
巧磨练到了极致。
当一名己方恐惧突袭小队特工进行射击时，如
果该特工没有在激活期间执行冲锋、后撤或转移
行动，或者如果目标特工没有掩护并且位于其 6"
外，那么它使用的远程武器拥有“平衡”武器规
则。请注意，上述的第一个条件不会限制特工在
射击之后执行相关的行动。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
STRATEGY PLOY
DEADLY SHOTS
Space Marines spend countless hours perfecting
their marksmanship.
Whenever a friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
operative is shooting during an activation in
which it hasn’t performed the Charge, Fall Back
or Reposition action, or against an operative
that isn’t in cover and is more than 6" from it,
that friendly operative’s ranged weapons have
the Balanced weapon rule. Note that for the first
requirement, that operative isn’t restricted from
performing those actions after shooting.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
战略计谋
致命突袭
星际战士们能够以极其猛烈且精准的方式将
敌人消灭。
每当一名己方恐惧突袭小队特工进行近战时，
其装备的近战武器拥有“平衡”武器规则。如
果那名己方特工在激活期间执行了冲锋行动，
那么其装备的近战武器还拥有“致命 5+”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
STRATEGY PLOY
LETHAL ASSAULTS
Space Marine warriors strike down their foes with
incredible power and precision.
Whenever a friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
operative is fighting, its melee weapons have the
Balanced weapon rule. If that friendly operative
is doing so during an activation in which it
performed the Charge action, its melee weapons
also have the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
交战计谋
耐心埋伏
恐惧突袭小队可以在原地静候数小时、数
日、甚至数周，在敌人毫无防备的时候发起
进攻。
在轮到您来激活一名己方特工时使用此交战计
谋。您可以跳过那一次激活。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PATIENT AMBUSH
A Phobos Strike Team may lay in wait for hours, days
or even weeks before launching an assault upon an
unsuspecting enemy.
Use this firefight ploy when it’s your turn to
activate a friendly operative. You can skip
that activation.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
交战计谋
射击要害
一次精准的射击足以将最为坚韧的敌人击毙。
在您为一名使用爆矢武器射击的己方恐惧突袭小
队特工结算一次关键成功时使用此交战计谋。
造成额外 D3 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CRITICAL SHOT
A well-placed bolt round can fell even the most resilient
of foes.
Use this firefight ploy when you resolve a critical
success for a friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
operative that’s shooting with a bolt weapon.
Inflict D3 additional damage.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
交战计谋
超人体格
经受了基因强化的星际战士能够承受那些对
凡人来说致命的重伤。
在一名特工对己方恐惧突袭小队特工进行射击
时使用此交战计谋。在掷防御骰步骤中，您可以
将一枚普通成功作为关键成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
The genetically modified physiology of a Space
Marine is capable of resisting wounds that would kill a
lesser being.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
operative, in the Roll Defence Dice step. You can
retain one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
交战计谋
隐匿突袭
恐惧型动力护甲之中安装的消声传动装置能
够让一名星际战士以惊人的速度向敌人发动
奇袭。
在一名拥有隐匿命令的己方恐惧突袭小队特工
被激活，获得交战命令，执行冲锋并在之后执行
近战行动时，在您结算那次激活的第一枚攻击骰
时使用此交战计谋。在完成结算后，您可以在对
手之前立即结算另一枚己方攻击骰。在这次激活
中该特工不能执行过任意其他行动（但是在结算
该计谋后可以）。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FIREFIGHT PLOY
STEALTH ASSAULT
The silenced servos of Phobos-pattern power armour
allow a Space Marine to strike swiftly and overwhelm a
surprised foe.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly PHOBOS
STRIKE TEAM operative that has a Conceal
order is activated, is given an Engage order,
performs the Charge and then the Fight action,
and you’re resolving your first attack dice
from this activation. After doing so, you can
immediately resolve another of your attack dice
(before your opponent). The operative cannot
have performed any other actions during this
activation (but can do so after resolving this ploy).

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营装备
纯洁印章
战团牧师会将纯洁印章授予星际战士，上面写
有的祝福能够让持有者更加奋勇作战。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方恐惧突袭小队
特工进行射击、近战或反击时，如果您掷出了两
次或更多失败，那么您可以将其中一次舍弃，并
将剩余的一次失败作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PURITY SEALS
Awarded by the Chapter’s Chaplains, purity seals are
inscribed with blessings and inspire the bearer to fight
with increased vigour.
Once per turning point, when a friendly PHOBOS
STRIKE TEAM operative is shooting, fighting or
retaliating, if you roll two or more fails, you can
discard one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营装备
额外功能型手雷
一些星际战士会选择携带额外的烟雾弹、震荡
弹和其他类型的投掷爆炸物。
这个装备允许您从功能型手雷装备中选择四枚功
能型手雷（参见通用装备)。您不能以常规方式
选择那个装备（如：给你六个）。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ADDITIONAL UTILITY GRENADES
Some Space Marines opt to carry additional smoke
grenades, shock grenades and other forms of
hand-held explosives.
This equipment allows you to select four utility
grenades from the utility grenades equipment
(see universal equipment). You cannot also select
that equipment as normal (i.e. to give you six).

cards.image: 40-03-阵营装备-名称攻击命中伤害.png
cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营装备
格斗刀
这些厚实的匕首极度锋利。
己方恐惧突袭小队特工拥有以下近战武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
格斗刀 5 3+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMBAT BLADES
These blades are tough, thick and possess a razor-sharp
cutting edge.
Friendly PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM operatives have
the following melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Combat blade 5 3+ 3/4

cards.text:
恐惧突袭小队
阵营装备
特种弹药
星际战士的爆矢武器能够装填各种特殊类型
的弹药。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方恐惧突袭小队
特工执行射击行动时，如果您选择使用爆矢卡
宾枪、神射手爆矢卡宾枪，或者全知者爆矢卡
宾枪，那么您可以使用本规则。若选择使用，那
么直到转折点结束前，那件武器拥有“穿刺 1”
规则。
cards.text_en:
PHOBOS STRIKE TEAM
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SPECIAL ISSUE AMMUNITION
Space Marine bolt weapons can be loaded with a variety
of special ammunition.
Once per turning point, when a friendly PHOBOS
STRIKE TEAM operative is performing the
Shoot action and you select a bolt carbine,
marksman bolt carbine or occulus bolt carbine,
you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of
the turning point, that weapon has the Piercing 1
weapon rule.
